annotations.title: Will this MCP server connect from my client?

description: Before adding a remote MCP server to a client, or when it fails to connect: give its url. One live read (initialize with protocol 2025-06-18 and 2025-11-25, tools/list, the 401 and OAuth metadata, the host's IPv4) and a verdict per client: claude_code, claude_ai, chatgpt, codex_cli, cursor, vscode, windsurf, gemini_cli, zed, cline, each ok, warn or fail with reasons (protocol version answered, OAuth discovery, S256 PKCE, dynamic client registration or client ID metadata documents, tool names, input schemas, tool count, description length). Also the tool list's weight in tokens (estimate and range). Rules come from each client's documentation and source code as of 2026-11-08: a prediction, not a test inside the client. Uses one of your daily live checks; answers are cached for 10 minutes.
